03 / SELECTED WORK

Projects

Healthcare · Data

Personalized Healthcare Dashboard

Built a personalized healthcare dashboard around a machine-learning classification workflow. The model pipeline uses LabelEncoder for categorical data, StandardScaler for feature scaling, and class weights to account for class imbalance. The dashboard presents patient-focused information and model insights in a clear, accessible format.

HealthcareAnalytics
Data Analytics

Schedule Optimization & Insights

Developed a schedule analytics dashboard to help understand utilization and attendance patterns. It highlights peak and lowest utilization days, average/highest/lowest utilization, expected attendance, and no-show figures so the schedule can be reviewed using measurable insights.

Data AnalyticsOptimization
NLP · Healthcare

Clinical Text Summarization & Intelligence Dashboard

Worked on the Appoynt AI-04 Clinical Summary Bot using Python and Pandas. The workflow cleans clinical text, uses regex and clinical keywords to extract relevant sentences, applies the generated summary to records, and supports exporting the resulting data as CSV. The goal is to make lengthy clinical notes easier to review while keeping the output tied to the source text.

PythonRegexNLP
Computer Vision · Culture

AI Landmark Audio Tour Guide

Created an AI-powered landmark experience that recognizes Egyptian landmarks and artifacts from a scan, then presents a story video to introduce the recognized place or object. The project combines computer-vision recognition with cultural storytelling. In the recorded test, the Tutankhamun artifact was detected with a confidence result of 0.87.
